chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Nzọụkwụ 1: Mole. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g ÷ 28 g/mol = 0.5 mol, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g ÷ 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Nzọụkwụ 2: Tụnyere uru e kewara site na coefficient. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0.5/1 = 0.5, $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0.67. $\mathrm{N_2}$ nwere obere uru bụ limiting reactant.
Nzọụkwụ 3: Mgbe $\mathrm{N_2}$ 0.5 mol meghachiri niile, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 1.5 mol na-eji, ma $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 1.0 mol na-apụta. Oke = 1.0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ fọdụrụ = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Nzọụkwụ 4: Ngụkọta mole gas mgbe mmeghachi omume gasịrị = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol → olu STP = 1.5 × 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Azịza: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Azịza ezighi ezi: 22.4 L leghaara anya H2 fọdụrụ, 34 g jikọrọ coefficient 2 n'ọnụọgụ mole NH3 ma mee ka mole N2·H2 gbagwojuo anya, 8.5 g weere N2 : NH3 = 1 : 1 n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi)
